vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: geo-prompt-architecture
Version: 0.1.0

The 'geo-prompt-architecture' skill bundle is a collection of Markdown instructions and JSON schemas designed to guide an AI agent in generating and auditing marketing prompts for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). The bundle contains no executable code, no requests for sensitive system access (e.g., environment variables or SSH keys), and no evidence of malicious prompt injection or data exfiltration. All content, including the workflow instructions in SKILL.md and the business logic in the references/ directory, is consistent with the stated purpose of helping marketing teams monitor brand visibility in AI search results.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only prompt-architecture guide and the files, requirements, and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (GEO prompt generation, scoring, auditing) match the included SKILL.md, examples, references, and JSON schemas. There are no unrelated required binaries, env vars, or config paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and supporting docs limit behavior to generating, auditing, scoring, and translating monitoring results into actions. The instructions reference only local repo schemas, examples, and optional live browsing for validation; they do not instruct reading system files, secrets, or unrelated configs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files — this is instruction-only documentation and schemas. That reduces the risk surface because nothing is downloaded or executed by an installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no primary credential, and no config paths. The SKILL.md states no private credentials are required for basic use; live browsing is optional but not mandated.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill flags are default (always: false, user-invocable true). It does not request permanent presence or elevated agent/system privileges and does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This repo is a documentation-first skill for designing GEO prompt systems and appears coherent. Before using it in production: (1) avoid pasting private analytics, Search Console, CRM data, or credentials into prompts unless you trust the environment; (2) enable any ‘live browsing’ or network access only if you understand what external requests your agent will make; (3) confirm the repo's provenance if you need a contractual or security assurance (README cites Dageno.ai but source is 'unknown'); and (4) if you later add automated scoring scripts or connectors that fetch data, review those components for network endpoints and credential handling.
llm.findings: [no-findings] expected: Regex scanner had no code files to analyze; this is an instruction-only repo of docs and schemas, so absence of findings is expected.
